summary: Every claim in the report matches the checks, snapshot, rendered pages and screenshots, and it honestly mentions the one cosmetic flaw (the title wrapping); the only thing it leaves out is a minor process slip (self-check screenshots saved in %TEMP%), which isn't breakage.

claims.claim: Site is running; front page lists both posts
claims.evidence: check.json: site.boots ok, GET / → 200, site.frontPageLinksPosts 2/2; the frontpage screenshot shows two post cards

claims.claim: Both posts render with all their blocks
claims.evidence: check.json crawl: both posts return 200 with no renderErrors and use block grid markup; the blogpost screenshot shows hero, rich text, quote and a half-width image with caption

claims.claim: Checked headless-browser screenshots of the front page and one post
claims.evidence: check.json process.stayedInFolder lists %TEMP%/front.png and post.png, which matches the claim (the grader marked the folder location as a minor process issue, not a false claim)

claims.claim: All schema, media and content created over MCP; no migrations
claims.evidence: check.json process.intendedChannel 'built through mcp', code.noMigrationsWritten ok; grade.json says 47 MCP calls and no Management API, DB or uSync use

claims.claim: Five blocks (Hero, Rich Text, Image, Quote, Blog Post List) in a Blocks folder; list shows posts newest first
claims.evidence: grade.md lists the 5 element types in Blocks; frontpage screenshot shows the 3 Oct post before the 24 Sep post

claims.claim: Two 12-column block grids; rich text and image can be full or half width
claims.evidence: snapshot.json gridColumns 12 on both grid data types; grade.md confirms full/half-width options

claims.claim: Blog Front Page sits under WWW and is the only type allowed there; Blog Post has a Teaser tab with publish date, teaser text and teaser image
claims.evidence: snapshot.json: siteRoot allowedChildren [blogFrontPage], Teaser tab holding the teaser text and teaser image properties; grade.md lists publishDate, teaserText and teaserImage
check.json counts templates 3; uSync Templates configs for all three

claims.claim: Six Unsplash photos in a 'Blog' media folder; photographers credited in heroes and captions
claims.evidence: check.json content.mediaFromProvidedPhotos 6/6, snapshot.json has a 'Blog' folder; pages/*.html show 'Photo by … on Unsplash' credits in heroes and figcaptions

claims.claim: Front page 'Blog' has domain '/', with hero, post list and quote; two posts with the stated titles, made of blocks
claims.evidence: check.json content.domainAssigned 'Blog: /', content.twoBlogPosts; frontpage screenshot shows hero, Latest posts and a quote

claims.claim: Adapters → ViewComponents, plain models in Models/Blocks and Models/Blog, BlogPostService registered in ProjectComposer, GetBlockGridHtmlAsync
claims.evidence: check.json code.adapterPerBlock, adaptersInvokeViewComponents 5/5, viewComponentPerBlock, pagesUseBlockGridHelper; the changes list includes Services/BlogPostService.cs and a modified ProjectComposer.cs

claims.claim: Ran npm build; site.css includes the grid and rich text styles
claims.evidence: check.json code.frontendBuilt, site.stylesheetsLoad 200; Frontend/src/site.css modified; screenshots render fully styled

claims.claim: Build had no errors or warnings; uSync exported types, data types, templates, content and media
claims.evidence: check.json build 0 errors and 0 warnings; uSync v18 ContentTypes, DataTypes, Templates, Content and Media configs were added

claims.claim: First post's title wraps 'AI' onto its own line in the hero
claims.evidence: the blogpost screenshot shows 'AI' alone on the second line of the hero title

claims.claim: Nothing is broken that I know of
claims.evidence: check.json has 42/43 checks passing; the only failure is the process check for screenshots saved in %TEMP%, which isn't a broken site feature; the grader found only minor issues
